edges.reason: msg.sender is compared with owner() and used as the mint recipient in mint
msg.sender is checked against presaleWallets and used as the mint recipient in preMint
withdraw transfers the whole balance to msg.sender
block.timestamp is consumed by the keccak256 randomness seed in nextToken, making token assignment miner influenceable
mint reads cost to enforce msg.value >= cost
mint requires public_paused to be false
mint compares current supply against maxSupply
nextToken() result is stored in the local id used for _safeMint in mint
mint stores totalSupply() in the local supply variable
preMint requires pre_mint to be below 500
preMint requires pre_paused to be false
preMint compares current supply against maxSupply
preMint reads presaleWallets[msg.sender] to gate the presale
preMint increments the pre_mint counter after minting
preMint stores totalSupply() in the local supply variable
nextToken() result is stored in the local id used for _safeMint in preMint
_baseURI returns the baseURI state variable
tokenURI calls _baseURI to obtain the current base URI
tokenURI concatenates baseExtension into the returned metadata URI
tokenURI stores _baseURI() in the local currentBaseURI
tokenId parameter is validated with _exists and stringified in tokenURI
the constructor calls setBaseURI with the initial URI parameter
_initBaseURI constructor parameter flows into setBaseURI
_name constructor parameter is passed to the ERC721 constructor
_symbol constructor parameter is passed to the ERC721 constructor
constructor passes maxSupply into RandomlyAssigned(maxSupply,1)
_newCost parameter is written into storage by setCost
setCost writes the new value into the cost state variable
_newPreCost parameter is written into storage by setPreCost
setPreCost writes the new value into the preCost state variable
_newBaseURI parameter is written into storage by setBaseURI
setBaseURI writes the new value into the baseURI state variable
_newBaseExtension parameter is written into storage by setBaseExtension
setBaseExtension writes the new value into the baseExtension state variable
startPublicSale sets public_paused to false
startPreSale sets pre_paused to false
stopPublicSale sets public_paused to true
stopPreSale sets pre_paused to true
the _users address array is iterated and written into the whitelist mapping
add50PresaleUsers marks each address in presaleWallets as true
the loop counter i controls the batch whitelisting in add50PresaleUsers
mint calls nextToken which performs the pseudo-random index computation
preMint calls nextToken which performs the pseudo-random index computation
mint calls _safeMint which triggers the recipient onERC721Received callback after state changes
preMint calls _safeMint which triggers the recipient onERC721Received callback before pre_mint is incremented
withdraw performs the payable transfer of the entire contract balance
